test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If θ is an acute angle and tan θ + cot θ = 2, then the value of tan200 θ + cot200 θ is:
solution:
Given:

tan θ + cot θ = 2

Concept used:

1. tan θ = 1/cot θ

2. (a - b)² = a² - 2ab + b²

Calculation:

tan θ + cot θ = 2

⇒ tan θ + 1/tan θ = 2

⇒ tan² θ - 2tan θ + 1 = 0

⇒ (tan θ - 1)² = 0

⇒ tan θ = 1

⇒ tan²⁰⁰ θ = 1²⁰⁰

⇒ tan²⁰⁰ θ = 1 ....(1)

So, cot θ = 1/tan θ 

⇒ cot θ = 1/1

⇒ cot²⁰⁰ θ = 1²⁰⁰

⇒ cot200 θ = 1 ....(2)

Now, (1) + (2)

tan200 θ + cot200 θ = 1 + 1

⇒ tan200 θ + cot200 θ = 2

**∴ The value of tan200 θ + cot200 θ is 2.**

⇒ tan45 = 1, cot 45 = 1

tan θ + cot θ = 2

than, tan200 θ + cot200 θ

⇒ 1²⁰⁰ + 1²⁰⁰

⇒ 2

∴ The value of tan200 θ + cot200 θ is 2.
